businessGoal: Allow users to filter items by different categories to enhance searchability

scenarios.goal: Users can filter items by a specific category and see relevant results.
Users do not see any results when filtering by a category with no matching items.

clarifications: The acceptance criteria do not specify how the filter behaves with no selection or multiple categories.

manual.reason: The story involves user interaction with the filter feature which has a UI component.

api.reason: The filter functionality can be validated through available API endpoints that provide filtered data.

ui.reason: The filtering by category would involve visible browser behavior and user interaction.
